tei:editionStmt.tei:p: Expanded Ashkenazi siddur: prayers in recitation order. Prayer words are transcluded from their source editions. Birnbaum supplies selected High Holiday services and rites, not a complete mahzor.

tei:sourceDesc.tei:bibl: This project arranges prayer text from Birnbaum 1949 and readings from the Humash and Tanakh editions. See the project index for the editorial arrangement.

tei:div.tei:head: הוֹשַׁעְנוֹת
HOSHANOTH
tei:div.tei:note:
On Sukkoth after Musaf—numbered for special days of the week:
If Monday is the first day of Sukkoth, the order is: א, ב, ה, ג, ו, ח.
If Tuesday is the first day of Sukkoth, the order is: א, ב, ה, ו, ח, ד.
If Thursday is the first day of Sukkoth, the order is: א, ב, ח, ה, ו, ד.
If Sabbath is the first day of Sukkoth, the order is: ח, א, ה, ב, ו, ד.
Number ז is added on days other than Sabbath.
On the seventh day of Sukkoth, all the Hoshanoth are recited.
